title: Prime Minister congratulates Ganesh Mani Ratnam Thirumuru on winning Bronze in Men’s Compound Individual at Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has congratulated Ganesh Mani Ratnam Thirumuru on his hard-fought victory in the Men’s Compound Individual Bronze Medal Match at the Asian Games.
Shri Modi said that with precision under pressure, remarkable composure and an unyielding spirit, Ganesh Mani Ratnam Thirumuru has brought immense glory.
The Prime Minister has extended his best wishes to Ganesh Mani Ratnam Thirumuru for his future endeavours.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister’s Office said;
“Congratulations to Ganesh Mani Ratnam Thirumuru on his hard-fought victory in the Men’s Compound Individual Bronze Medal Match at the Asian Games. With precision under pressure, remarkable composure and an unyielding spirit, Ganesh has brought immense glory. Best wishes to him for future endeavours: PM @narendramodi”
